method: Read-only JSON/text examination and stdlib identity comparisons. No production imports, propagation, replay, tests, Skill execution, model calls, or process operations. Only this new evidence file is written.

relevant_checklist.expected_relation: Preserve explicit autosave requirement, optional save gates and combined saves. siteOverview may save both child responses and its combined object. compareDateRanges disables two child saves but saves the combined object. Sensitivity alone cannot establish these declared saves are unnecessary.
relevant_checklist.incorrect_or_unestablished_claim: All automatic saves are DOE merely because persistent, or all save:false helper calls are nevertheless separately persisted; a save requirement makes every downstream disclosure necessary.

relevant_checklist.expected_relation: Three explicit source loops are finite/unknown input-array for-of loops. Lowered CFG cursors/backedges must preserve membership and exhaustion. Array maps preserve member transformations; no source-level retry, pagination or nested explicit for-of loop is implemented here.
relevant_checklist.incorrect_or_unestablished_claim: Report this GA4 run as real-source proof of general retry, pagination or nested-loop support; source offset means repeated pagination.

assessment: The source awaits each requestIndexing(url, {save:false}), appends that returned notification, then conditionally saves the complete collection and returns it. There is no per-member catch.

The CFG has member and exhaustion branches, a backedge after append, and a separate save gate at ir_174. The saved child-call summary has no child storage write. It has one normal remote request/response pair plus response-time versus fallback-clock result candidates.
The final write is a computed possible boundary under normal traversal and a truthy save gate; its existence does not establish successful completion for all inputs or all errors.

The source protected region includes URL logging, requestIndexing(url,{save:false}), and pushing {url,status:submitted,...result}; catch logs the original URL and pushes {url,status:failed,error:String(error)}.

The graph has three caught predecessors (logging, child call, construction/append), an exception merge at ir_137, normal and failed collection contributions, and a loop-exhaustion exit before save and return.

The normal success item at ir_133/e1 is opaque with possible dependencies on original URL, submitted literal, and returned notification. Therefore the preserved source spread override is described but its exact final fields are not computed in saved content.

Pre-submission error has no remote delivery; post-submission error has delivery at ir_131/e22 and an exception acquisition, without claiming a successful normal response. Received-response-before-error versions and partial mutation if push throws remain documented gaps.
The source calls inspectUrl(url,{save:false}), appends the original URL, verdict === PASS, and only result.indexStatus. Catch appends original URL, indexed:false, and status.error from String(error).

The normal child return is an opaque constructed result at ir_152/e7. The parent selects returned.indexStatus at ir_154/e0, then verdict at e1, computes the comparison at e2, and explicitly builds url/indexed/status at e3 before append.

The selected annotation supplies the exact eq expression for PASS, but the saved indexed value remains opaque, since the response verdict is unknown. The known_parts parent record does not include mobileUsability or richResults.

Pre-submission error has no remote delivery; post-submission error has delivery at ir_152/e16 and an exception acquisition. Internal optional inspection-result fields and defaults are not expanded at this caller coordinate; the standalone inspectUrl branch is not substitute evidence.

documented_processing_gaps.reason: Each loop occurrence has its own child acquisition and actual normal or thrown alternative. Publication uses that occurrence's original URL and URL_UPDATED. The constructed notification uses response metadata URL or the original URL; only a falsy latestUpdate notification time acquires a fallback clock. The success projection's later spread may replace its original URL. A post-submission failure may occur before a normal response or during response processing; the retained delivery alone does not identify a successful response. The summary does not separately retain every such received-response-before-error version.

The append summary preserves normal collection contribution and actual exceptions but does not identify the exact partial mutation when a protected push itself throws. Catch-body logging, String(error) and the failure push can also throw outside the try. Such failure prevents the following backedge, final save and return; earlier request and cache effects are not rolled back.

The member-specific inspection response is acquired separately from the URL request. Its opaque constructed-result computation must retain the source projection: inspection link, indexStatus with NEUTRAL/Unknown fallbacks and optional index fields, mobileUsability only for a truthy mobile section, and richResults only for a truthy rich section. Those conditional sections are not expanded at this caller coordinate. The independently selected inspectUrl branches do not provide caller-coordinate branch execution. Only returned.indexStatus is retained by checkIndexStatus; reading the whole child return does not make mobile or rich-result fields task requirements.

The explicit loop summaries retain source occurrence identity, order and duplicates through member, predecessor merge and append. Normal checkIndexStatus rows preserve the original URL, compare verdict strictly with PASS and retain only indexStatus; caught failures append indexed:false and status.error from the actual caught exception. Empty input executes no member acquisition. requestIndexingBatch has no per-member catch, so a complete collection and optional final save exist only on normal traversal. The summaries do not infer a singleton iteration, precise cache-hit count or unconditional cache overwrite.

The saved JSON wrapper and its UTF-8 representation are distinct from the original returned data. JSON.stringify can omit undefined object properties; undefined is not silently changed into JSON null. Serialization or writing may throw. The write replaces the selected path and has no public file-content output. A second-precision timestamp and sanitized operation/extra do not supply a unique invocation identity. Metadata uses current propertyId and omits Search Console site identity.

limitations: Computed means a persisted propagation alternative exists. No source loop or remote API was executed by this audit, and no count is an observed iteration or endpoint-call count.

The three member Data identities have distinct explicit loop scopes and transfer bindings. The corresponding request, response, success and failure items retain those bindings. This establishes the inspected identity relationships, not universal semantic equivalence of the generated model to source.

Collection identities retain predecessor and accumulated_collection variants. Multiple-generation predecessor ambiguity is explicit in some reindex/status collections; exact length, member order realization, feasibility and complete concrete sequence are not proven by these summaries.

Final save uses an opaque serialization computation with possible dependencies on the final collection, category, operation, propertyId and savedAt. The collection ID set agrees with the return input, but the serialized payload is a distinct Data version. A possible dependency is not a proof that every source field is written in plaintext.

Symbolic save path, directory creation, filename construction and failure ordering are scoped gaps. The saved write has no public output. A common symbolic storage label is not proof of aliasing or uniqueness between invocations.
Catch-body logging, String(error), failure append, serialization and writing can throw; earlier effects need not roll back. These non-cutting gaps do not make all modeled final writes unconditional.

No new missing loop source boundary or propagation cutoff was found in this narrow audit. Existing opaque construction and incomplete error-version detail are processing-precision gaps. This is not a general accuracy score.
